request.input:
Bill number: HB1178
<bill_text>
HOUSE BILL 1178

 By Sherrell

 AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 49,
 relative to education.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF THE STATE OF TENNESSEE:

 SECTION 1. Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 49-8-117, is amended by deleting

subsection (c) and substituting:

 (c) Upon the request of the education committee of the senate or the committee

 of the house of representatives having jurisdiction over subject matters pertaining to

 education, the board of regents, a state university board, or the board of trustees of the

 University of Tennessee shall provide a report to the requesting committee summarizing

 grievance activities of the previous year.

 SECTION 2. This act takes effect July 1, 2025, the public welfare requiring it.
</bill_text>

<source_propositions_json>
[{"id": "P1", "proposition": "Replaces Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 49-8-117(c), to require the board of regents, a state university board, or the University of Tennessee board of trustees, upon request by the senate education committee or the house committee having jurisdiction over education matters, to provide the requesting committee a report summarizing the previous year's grievance activities.", "importance": "core", "section": "SECTION 1", "source_quote": "shall provide a report to the requesting committee summarizing\n\n grievance activities of the previous year."}, {"id": "P2", "proposition": "The act takes effect July 1, 2025.", "importance": "supporting", "section": "SECTION 2", "source_quote": "This act takes effect July 1, 2025, the public welfare requiring it."}]
</source_propositions_json>

<summary>
This bill would replace subsection (c) of Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 49-8-117, which deals with education. The bill does not show what the old subsection said, so its prior rule is not described here. Under the new text, the Senate education committee, or the House committee that handles education subjects, could ask for a report. The request could go to the board of regents, a state university board, or the University of Tennessee board of trustees. Upon such a request, that board would have to give the requesting committee a report summarizing its grievance activities from the previous year. The bill does not define grievance activities or set a deadline for the report. The bill would take effect July 1, 2025.
</summary>
